تستحقوا (form X)
# تَسْتَحِقُّوا (tastaḥiqqū) /tas.ta.ħiq.quː/: second-person masculine plural non-past active subjunctive/jussive of اِسْتَحَقَّ (istaḥaqqa)
# تُسْتَحَقُّوا (tustaḥaqqū) /tus.ta.ħaq.quː/: second-person masculine plural non-past passive subjunctive/jussive of اِسْتَحَقَّ (istaḥaqqa)
kaikki_vikisozluk.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
